html.Qué ocurre con tus archivos y tus datos: What happens to your files and data when you use FasTools.
FasTools does not require an account or sign-up. The image and PDF tools process files in your browser, so they are not uploaded to the server.
html.Las herramientas de vídeo, audio y QR sí: The video, audio and QR tools do use the server to complete the task. Files are processed temporarily, kept in memory only as long as needed for you to download them, and deleted when the task finishes or during periodic cleanup. They are not used for other purposes or shared with third parties.
html.El servidor puede registrar la dirección: The server may log the IP address, date, browser and requested URL to keep the service available and prevent abuse. This data is not used to build profiles or sold.
html.No usamos cookies de analítica ni de pub: We do not use analytics or advertising cookies. We only store your theme preference (light or dark) in your browser's local storage; that data is not sent to the server.
html.El alojamiento y la infraestructura técn: The hosting and technical infrastructure may process data on behalf of the project. If you choose to donate through Ko-fi, you leave FasTools and Ko-fi's privacy policy applies. The tools do not send your files to external APIs.
